summary: Iteration-6 verified end-to-end: (a) PUT /api/water-quality/{hw}/do-tank-config — admin-only, do_meter-only (STP returns 400), unknown hw returns 404, client returns 403; response includes success:true and do_tank_config with tank_1_kld/tank_2_kld/updated_by/updated_at. (b) GET /api/water-quality/latest — admin sees full do_tank_config with updated_by/updated_at; client sees tank_1_kld+tank_2_kld only (updated_by/updated_at stripped by sanitizer). (c) PUT /api/water-quality/{hw}/stp-config accepts param_ranges (COD/BOD/TSS/PH each with min+max) and dummy_auto_push {enabled, interval_seconds}; response echoes both. (d) When dummy_auto_push.enabled=true, registry.dummy_config is synced: enabled=true, auto_from_stp_cfg=true, interval_seconds=86400, min_value=5.0 (lowest = BOD.min), max_value=250.0 (highest = COD.max). Toggling enabled=false flips registry.dummy_config.enabled back to false (since auto_from_stp_cfg was true). (e) dummy_data_service._generate_wq_stp respects stp_unit_config.param_ranges — 5 consecutive readings all within COD[30,250], BOD[5,30], TSS[10,100], PH[6.5,8.5] and values vary (not constant). Frontend admin flows on /water-quality: DO tab shows do-configure-tanks-btn, opens do-tank-config-dialog prefilled with 250/180, edit to 300/220 and save updates SVG chip labels to 'Cap: 300 KLD' / 'Cap: 220 KLD'; NO aeration-custom-badge elements present. STP tab Configure Plant dialog exposes all four range cards (stpcfg-range-COD/-BOD/-TSS/-PH) each with -min/-max children, auto-push checkbox (stpcfg-dummy-auto-push-enabled) toggles interval field (stpcfg-dummy-interval) visibility correctly. Client (testclient@envirolytics.com) after ownership reassignment: DO tab shows tank capacity chips correctly (Cap: 250 KLD / Cap: 180 KLD), do-configure-tanks-btn is hidden, stp-configure-plant-btn is hidden, aeration-upload-btn count = 0, aeration-custom-badge count = 0. 12/12 pytest tests pass in 2.79s. Ownership of DO_TEST_001 and STP_TEST_001 RESTORED to user_52eee1f7927c after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: api_water_quality.update_stp_config correctly computes overall_lo/overall_hi for dummy_config using min(all .min) / max(all .max) across param_ranges — the per-parameter walk still uses the tighter per-key band inside _generate_wq_stp; the overall band is only a legacy safety-net for the generator's outer cfg.min_value/max_value fields. Good defense in depth.

update_stp_config only flips dummy_config.enabled=false on toggle-off IF the existing dummy_config was set via auto_from_stp_cfg — so a manually-enabled dummy generator on the Instruments page is not accidentally disabled by an STP-config edit. Correct.

DOTankConfig is admin-gated (Depends(require_admin)), enforces do_meter type (400 on STP), and stores updated_by/updated_at. _sanitize_stp_cfg_for_client / /latest handler explicitly strips updated_by/updated_at from do_tank_config for non-admin callers — verified empirically.

_generate_wq_stp param_ranges lookup uses `float(hi) <= float(lo)` as the fall-through condition — this means degenerate/reversed bands silently fall back to defaults instead of raising. That's ergonomic for admins but the STP-config PUT does not currently validate min<max on param_ranges — a user could save COD.min=100, COD.max=30 and the generator would silently use the defaults. Minor UX polish but not a functional bug.
The frontend AerationTank component receives capacityKld from do_tank_config.tank_N_kld with a fallback to the legacy plant-wide tank_capacity_kld — clean deprecation path.

STPConfigDialog renders the interval field with an early-return pattern (`form.dummy_auto_push.enabled && (<div>...`) — data-testid=stpcfg-dummy-interval is only queryable when the checkbox is checked, matching the requirement.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin DO/STP + client DO/STP flows all pass)

rca of the issue: N/A — all iteration_6 features function as specified. One minor UX gap: STP-config PUT does not validate that param_ranges.<K>.min < .max; misconfigured bands silently fall back to defaults inside the dummy generator. Suggest adding a Pydantic validator to ParamRange (or STPParamRanges) to surface a 400 to the admin instead of letting the offline safety-net silently ignore the intent.
